title: Kirby Problem 4.94
exact_target: Are homotopy-equivalent Horikawa surfaces in different complex deformation classes nevertheless diffeomorphic, and are their canonical symplectic structures symplectomorphic?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2970 (KP-4.94). CC BY 4.0.
